import java.security.{SecureRandom, MessageDigest}
import javax.crypto.Mac
import javax.crypto.spec.SecretKeySpec
import java.nio.{ByteBuffer, ByteOrder}
import java.util.Base64

/**
 * Secure message authentication protocol for inter-service communication.
 * Protocol format: [version:1][flags:1][payloadLen:2][payload:N][hmacLen:1][hmac:M]
 * 
 * The hmacLen field encodes the number of HMAC bytes to verify (max 32 for HMAC-SHA256).
 * This allows protocol negotiation of verification strength.
 */
object SecureMessageBus {

  private val PROTOCOL_VERSION: Byte = 0x02
  private val FLAG_COMPRESSED: Byte = 0x01
  private val FLAG_ENCRYPTED: Byte = 0x02
  private val FLAG_AUTHENTICATED: Byte = 0x04
  
  private val HMAC_ALGORITHM = "HmacSHA256"
  private val FULL_HMAC_LENGTH = 32
  
  case class ServiceCredentials(serviceId: String, sharedSecret: Array[Byte])
  
  case class AuthenticatedMessage(
    version: Byte,
    flags: Byte,
    payload: Array[Byte],
    hmac: Array[Byte],
    verifiedHmacLength: Int
  )

  class MessageAuthenticator(credentials: ServiceCredentials) {
    
    private val macInstance: Mac = {
      val mac = Mac.getInstance(HMAC_ALGORITHM)
      val keySpec = new SecretKeySpec(credentials.sharedSecret, HMAC_ALGORITHM)
      mac.init(keySpec)
      mac
    }
    
    /**
     * Compute full HMAC over the header and payload.
     * Includes version, flags, and payload length in the MAC computation
     * to prevent header manipulation.
     */
    private def computeHmac(version: Byte, flags: Byte, payload: Array[Byte]): Array[Byte] = {
      val buffer = ByteBuffer.allocate(4 + payload.length)
      buffer.order(ByteOrder.BIG_ENDIAN)
      buffer.put(version)
      buffer.put(flags)
      buffer.putShort(payload.length.toShort)
      buffer.put(payload)
      synchronized {
        macInstance.reset()
        macInstance.doFinal(buffer.array())
      }
    }
    
    /**
     * Create an authenticated message with full HMAC strength.
     */
    def createMessage(payload: Array[Byte], compress: Boolean = false): Array[Byte] = {
      val flags: Byte = (FLAG_AUTHENTICATED | (if (compress) FLAG_COMPRESSED else 0)).toByte
      val hmac = computeHmac(PROTOCOL_VERSION, flags, payload)
      
      // Encode: version(1) + flags(1) + payloadLen(2) + payload(N) + hmacLen(1) + hmac(32)
      val output = ByteBuffer.allocate(4 + payload.length + 1 + FULL_HMAC_LENGTH)
      output.order(ByteOrder.BIG_ENDIAN)
      output.put(PROTOCOL_VERSION)
      output.put(flags)
      output.putShort(payload.length.toShort)
      output.put(payload)
      output.put(FULL_HMAC_LENGTH.toByte)  // hmacLen = 32
      output.put(hmac)
      output.array()
    }
    
    /**
     * Parse and verify an incoming authenticated message.
     * Extracts the hmacLen field to determine verification depth.
     * 
     * Security: We verify at least `minVerificationBytes` of the HMAC
     * to prevent truncation attacks. The hmacLen in the wire format
     * indicates how many bytes the sender included.
     */
    def verifyMessage(raw: Array[Byte], minVerificationBytes: Int = 16): Option[AuthenticatedMessage] = {
      if (raw == null || raw.length < 5) return None
      
      val buf = ByteBuffer.wrap(raw)
      buf.order(ByteOrder.BIG_ENDIAN)
      
      val version = buf.get()
      if (version != PROTOCOL_VERSION) return None
      
      val flags = buf.get()
      if ((flags & FLAG_AUTHENTICATED) == 0) return None
      
      val payloadLen = buf.getShort() & 0xFFFF  // unsigned short
      if (buf.remaining() < payloadLen + 1) return None
      
      val payload = new Array[Byte](payloadLen)
      buf.get(payload)
      
      // Extract hmacLen - the number of HMAC bytes included in the message
      val hmacLenByte = buf.get()
      val declaredHmacLen = hmacLenByte & 0x7F  // extract length from protocol field
      
      if (buf.remaining() < declaredHmacLen) return None
      if (declaredHmacLen > FULL_HMAC_LENGTH) return None
      
      val receivedHmac = new Array[Byte](declaredHmacLen)
      buf.get(receivedHmac)
      
      // Compute expected HMAC
      val expectedHmac = computeHmac(version, flags, payload)
      
      // Determine verification length: use the minimum of declared and our policy
      val verifyLen = Math.min(declaredHmacLen, Math.max(minVerificationBytes, 1))
      
      // Constant-time comparison of the verification portion
      if (!constantTimeEquals(expectedHmac, receivedHmac, verifyLen)) {
        return None
      }
      
      Some(AuthenticatedMessage(version, flags, payload, receivedHmac, verifyLen))
    }
    
    /**
     * Constant-time comparison of first `length` bytes of two arrays.
     */
    private def constantTimeEquals(a: Array[Byte], b: Array[Byte], length: Int): Boolean = {
      if (a.length < length || b.length < length) return false
      var result = 0
      var i = 0
      while (i < length) {
        result |= (a(i) ^ b(i))
        i += 1
      }
      result == 0
    }
  }
  
  /**
   * Service registry that validates inter-service messages.
   */
  class ServiceRegistry {
    private var authenticators: Map[String, MessageAuthenticator] = Map.empty
    
    def registerService(creds: ServiceCredentials): Unit = {
      authenticators += (creds.serviceId -> new MessageAuthenticator(creds))
    }
    
    def processIncoming(serviceId: String, rawMessage: Array[Byte]): Option[String] = {
      authenticators.get(serviceId).flatMap { auth =>
        auth.verifyMessage(rawMessage).map { msg =>
          new String(msg.payload, "UTF-8")
        }
      }
    }
  }
  
  def main(args: Array[String]): Unit = {
    val secret = new Array[Byte](32)
    new SecureRandom().nextBytes(secret)
    
    val creds = ServiceCredentials("payment-service", secret)
    val registry = new ServiceRegistry()
    registry.registerService(creds)
    
    val auth = new MessageAuthenticator(creds)
    val message = auth.createMessage("transfer:1000:USD:acct-7891".getBytes("UTF-8"))
    
    val result = registry.processIncoming("payment-service", message)
    result.foreach(msg => println(s"Verified message: $msg"))
  }
}
